what: The trace PS4 expands BASH_SOURCE, which is unset in a -c snippet; any run_snippet that does set -u fails on the bash leg only. Also busybox sh runs applets (stat, id) before PATH stubs, so stubbing them is a no-op on that leg.
tell: bash: line 1: BASH_SOURCE: unbound variable on the bash leg only; busybox leg ignores stat/id stubs
